name: SmartWoo – AI Product Studio for WooCommerce
author: CoderVex

sections.description:
Your AI Product Studio Inside WooCommerce

Turn your WooCommerce products into professional product photoshoots, gallery images, videos, landing pages, SEO-ready content and more — directly from WordPress.

SmartWoo is built specifically for WooCommerce product workflows. Instead of moving between AI chat tools, image generators, video tools and WordPress, choose a product and create the assets you need from one workspace.

No prompt engineering is required for normal workflows. No repetitive downloading and re-uploading. No switching between multiple AI tools.

SmartWoo connects your store to the hosted SmartWoo API. An administrator chooses when to generate, previews the result, and decides when content, media, FAQs or pages are saved in WordPress.

Product-first tools

  1. AI Product Photoshoot — create four coordinated product angles from an existing product photo or verified WooCommerce product information.
  2. AI Product Video — turn product information and an optional reference image into promotional product motion.
  3. AI Product Gallery — generate a cohesive set of supporting product images and publish selected images to the WooCommerce gallery.
  4. AI Product Landing Page — create an editable Gutenberg landing or sales page from product data.
  5. Complete Product Content & SEO — generate reviewable titles, short and full descriptions, tags, SEO metadata, keywords, image alt text and product attributes.
  6. AI Product FAQ Generator — generate, edit and display product-specific FAQs.
  7. AI Bulk Generate — update content, SEO, alt text or featured images across selected products, or create review-ready product drafts.

AI Product Photoshoot

Turn a real product photo into a coordinated professional product photoshoot.

  1. Select a WooCommerce product.
  2. Use its existing image or choose another product reference from the Media Library.
  3. Optionally choose or upload a model/reference person, or create model candidates.
  4. Choose a presentation style, background or scene, format and quality.
  5. Generate four coordinated photoshoot angles.
  6. Preview and select a result.
  7. Use the selected result as the product featured image, publish it to the product gallery, or save it to the WordPress Media Library.

The coordinated set comprises Front Hero, Three-Quarter, Side / Profile, and Detail / In-use views. When a product reference is supplied, the workflow is designed to preserve its visible appearance, including color, shape, texture, labels and packaging. AI-generated details can vary, so always review results before publishing.

One Product → Complete AI Product Workflow

Product Photoshoot → Product Gallery → Product Video → Landing Page → Product Content & SEO → FAQs → Bulk Generate

Start with a WooCommerce product and create multiple types of product-marketing assets without leaving WordPress. SmartWoo carries the product context into each dedicated tool, then gives you a preview or draft before the result is applied.

AI Product Video

Create promotional product videos from verified product details and, optionally, a featured or gallery image. Choose from the video models and supported formats returned by your SmartWoo account, select aspect ratio, duration, resolution and creative direction, then review the generated video.

Video generation uses SmartWoo credits and may take several minutes. Completed videos can be previewed and downloaded; the plugin can also import them into the WordPress Media Library. Availability depends on the connected plan and models exposed by the SmartWoo API.

AI Product Gallery

Generate two to four coordinated supporting images with varied angles, crops, scenes or product use cases. SmartWoo requests a consistent visual treatment across the set. Preview the images, select the ones you want, and add them to the WooCommerce product gallery or save them to the WordPress Media Library.

AI Product Landing Page

Create a product-focused landing or sales page using verified WooCommerce product data. Choose a product-promotion, sales-campaign or store-showcase direction and create the page as a draft or, for users with permission, publish it directly.

The result is an editable WordPress Gutenberg page. Draft mode is recommended so merchants can review layout, product claims and calls to action before publishing. Access depends on the connected SmartWoo plan.

Complete Product Content & SEO

Generate and review individual fields or a coordinated content set:

  • Product title
  • Short description
  • Full description
  • Product tags
  • SEO title
  • Meta description
  • SEO keywords
  • Featured-image alt text
  • Product attributes

Generated results remain in preview until an authorized user applies them. SmartWoo stores its SEO title, keywords and meta description in SmartWoo product metadata; it does not claim automatic integration with every third-party SEO plugin.

AI Product FAQ Generator

Generate product-specific questions and answers from the selected product’s verified information. Review and edit every answer before saving. FAQs can appear in a WooCommerce product tab, after the description, in both locations, or through the [smartwoo_faqs] shortcode. SmartWoo also outputs FAQPage structured data for saved, displayed FAQs.

AI Bulk Generate

Select up to 50 products per batch and generate one or more supported tasks:

  • Complete content: title, descriptions, tags, SEO metadata and alt text
  • Full product descriptions
  • SEO meta descriptions
  • Featured-image alt text
  • One featured product image

Successful bulk results are applied to the selected products. SmartWoo can also create up to 10 new WooCommerce product drafts from a product-range idea, with an optional featured image for each draft. Drafts remain unpublished for merchant review.

Bulk Product Photoshoot is not included in this release.

Why SmartWoo?

General-purpose AI workflow: Product → upload or describe → write a prompt → generate → download → open WordPress → upload → assign

SmartWoo workflow: WooCommerce Product → Generate → Preview → Publish

SmartWoo does not claim that its underlying AI output is better than general-purpose AI tools. Its advantage is the WooCommerce-native workflow:

  • Work from the WooCommerce product and its existing information.
  • Reuse existing product and gallery images as references.
  • Use guided settings instead of writing prompts for routine workflows.
  • Avoid repetitive download and upload steps for supported media actions.
  • Publish selected images directly to the featured-image or gallery slots.
  • Create photos, videos, pages, content, SEO and FAQs in one interface.
  • Process supported content and image tasks in bulk.

External services and privacy

SmartWoo relies on the hosted SmartWoo API, operated by CoderVex, for account verification, plan entitlements, usage and credit information, available models and providers, AI generation, cloud asset storage, and generation-job status. The plugin does not connect directly to third-party AI providers and does not store AI-provider credentials in WordPress.

API base URL: https://www.codervex.com/api/v1/

The plugin may contact the service:

  • When an administrator submits a SmartWoo API token for verification.
  • While connected SmartWoo administration screens load account, subscription, usage, entitlement, model or provider information.
  • When an authorized administrator starts text, SEO, FAQ, image, video, landing-page, bulk or product-draft generation.
  • While an asynchronous generation job is checked for status and results.
  • When an administrator views or imports a cloud-generated asset.
  • Through an unauthenticated health request used to check API availability.

Depending on the operation selected by the administrator, data sent to the SmartWoo API may include:

  • The SmartWoo API token in an HTTPS Authorization header.
  • A one-way SHA-256 hash of the site URL as a site identifier, and the site URL in the request user-agent.
  • Selected product data including name, product type, SKU, descriptions, categories, tags, attributes, variations, dimensions, price and existing SmartWoo SEO fields.
  • Generation settings including language, tone, audience, instructions, brand voice, provider/model selection, output limits, image settings, video settings and optional prompts.
  • Product or model/reference images selected by the administrator. Image-generation references are read from the WordPress Media Library and sent inline to the API; video requests may include a selected image URL.
  • Job, generation and cloud-asset identifiers needed to retrieve status or results.

SmartWoo’s product-generation workflows do not send customer checkout details, payment-card information or WooCommerce order data.

The API token is verified before storage. It is encrypted in the WordPress options table using the site’s WordPress authentication salt and Sodium or OpenSSL, and it is not exposed to browser-side scripts. Non-local API requests are required to use HTTPS.

Use of the SmartWoo API is subject to these service policies:

  • SmartWoo service information: https://www.codervex.com/products/smartwoo-wordpress
  • Terms of Service: https://www.codervex.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.codervex.com/privacy-policy
  • Pricing and plan information: https://www.codervex.com/pricing
sections.installation:
1. Upload the smartwoo directory to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate SmartWoo from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Open SmartWoo > Account in WordPress administration.
  5. Create a SmartWoo account if needed, enter the SmartWoo API token, and choose Verify and connect.
  6. Open SmartWoo > Product Photoshoot and select a product to begin.
sections.faq:
What is SmartWoo?

SmartWoo is an AI product studio built into WordPress for WooCommerce workflows. It helps merchants create and manage product photoshoots, galleries, videos, landing pages, content, SEO fields, FAQs and supported bulk tasks.

Is SmartWoo an AI image generator?

Yes, image generation is one part of SmartWoo. The plugin also connects generated assets to WooCommerce products and includes video, page, content, SEO, FAQ and bulk workflows.

How is SmartWoo different from general AI tools?

SmartWoo works from a selected WooCommerce product, provides guided product workflows, previews results, and can apply supported assets directly in WordPress. The difference is workflow and integration, not a claim of superior AI output.

Do I need my own AI API key?

You do not enter third-party AI-provider keys in WordPress. You need a SmartWoo account and SmartWoo API token. Provider selection and credentials are managed by the hosted SmartWoo service.

Can SmartWoo use my existing WooCommerce product image?

Yes. The featured product image or another selected Media Library image can be supplied as the product reference for photoshoots and gallery generation. A product image can also be used as an optional video reference.

Can I use a model/reference person for Product Photoshoot?

Yes. You can choose or upload an optional model/reference-person image, or generate four model candidates and select one. Reference images must be JPEG, PNG or WebP and no larger than 10 MB.

Can generated images be published directly to WooCommerce?

Yes. After previewing a generated image, an authorized user can set it as the featured product image or add it to the product gallery.

Can I save generated images to the Media Library?

Yes. Selected images can be imported into the WordPress Media Library without assigning them to a product image slot.

Does SmartWoo support bulk generation?

Yes. Current bulk tasks cover complete product content, descriptions, SEO meta descriptions, featured-image alt text and one featured image. Bulk Product Photoshoot is not currently implemented.

How do SmartWoo credits work?

Generation uses the credits and limits associated with the connected SmartWoo plan. The Dashboard shows the balance reported by the API, and the video workspace shows an estimate when the service provides one. Actual availability and cost depend on the selected operation and model.

Does SmartWoo modify products automatically?

Single-product tools use a preview-first workflow and change WordPress only when an authorized user applies content, imports media, saves FAQs or creates a page. Bulk generation is different: successful results are applied to products selected when the batch is started. Newly generated products are saved as drafts.

Which WooCommerce and WordPress versions are supported?

This release requires WordPress 6.5 or later, PHP 8.1 or later, and WooCommerce 8.0 or later. The plugin header and the compatibility fields above are the authoritative requirements for this release.

Can I disconnect the service?

Yes. Use SmartWoo > Account > Disconnect this site to remove the locally stored SmartWoo credential.

What happens to plugin data on uninstall?

SmartWoo includes a delete-data setting. When enabled, uninstall removes SmartWoo options, cached data, scheduled events and plugin database records. Review this setting before uninstalling if you want to retain approved content.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Introduced the AI Product Photoshoot workflow with four coordinated angles.
  • Added optional product and model/reference-person image workflows and AI model candidates.
  • Added direct featured-image, product-gallery and Media Library actions for generated images.
  • Added AI Product Video generation, preview, download and Media Library import.
  • Added editable Gutenberg Product Landing Page generation.
  • Added coordinated AI Product Gallery generation and publishing tools.
  • Added product-specific FAQ generation, display controls, shortcode and structured data.
  • Added bulk content, SEO, alt-text and featured-image generation plus product-draft creation.
  • Improved the product content and SEO workspace, SmartWoo navigation and account reporting.
  • Repositioned SmartWoo as an AI Product Studio for WooCommerce.
  • Updated WordPress.org documentation and screenshot captions.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordPress.org release.
